title: Rhythm Quest
subtitle: Coloring Book
tagline: Staying on the path. Always learning.
cover_alt: Seriphia standing on a floating island of flowers, gems circling her hands

intro.title: Be the hero of your own learning.
intro.lede: Inside are {n} pages from the Rhythm Quest — the lands, the friends, and the animals your child meets along the path. Print them one at a time or all at once. There is no wrong color and no wrong order.

cards.title: Say it out loud
cards.body: Read the line at the top of each page together before the crayons come out.

cards.title: Take your time
cards.body: One page a day is plenty. Slow hands build steady focus.

cards.title: Hang it up
cards.body: Finished pages belong on the wall. Every one is a step on the path.

intro.kicker: Designed for the developing brain — not the algorithm.

plates.title: Hear the call
plates.prompt: Music drifts over the hills. Color the ribbon of notes leading the way.

plates.title: Seriphia calls
plates.prompt: Your guide sings from the clouds. What color is her song?

plates.title: Step onto the path
plates.prompt: Every hero starts with one step. Color the great stone gate.

plates.title: The long road
plates.prompt: Look at all the friends walking with you. Give each one a color.

plates.title: Alphabet jump
plates.prompt: Hop from A to Z. Color your three favorite letters first.

plates.title: Shapes ahead
plates.prompt: Circles, triangles, squares — color each shape a different color.

plates.title: Into Numeria
plates.prompt: Numbers hide in the canyon walls. How many can you find?

plates.title: Stepping stones
plates.prompt: Color the stones under her feet, one by one.

plates.title: Over the hill
plates.prompt: The whole tribe is running. Color the grass any color you like.

plates.title: A game of tag
plates.prompt: Color the trees, then draw yourself into the game.

plates.title: Take a big breath
plates.prompt: Breathe in. Breathe out. Color the sunbeams above you.

plates.title: Listen close
plates.prompt: Notes float across the field. Color the melody.

plates.title: Look how far
plates.prompt: Under the music arch, look back at the road you walked.

plates.title: In the orchard
plates.prompt: Two ponies say hello. Color the apples first.

plates.title: Field of tulips
plates.prompt: So many flowers! Try a new color for every row.

plates.title: Flower crowns
plates.prompt: Color the sunflowers tall and bright.

plates.title: An apple for the pony
plates.prompt: Be gentle. Color the pony soft and warm.

plates.title: Out to pasture
plates.prompt: Color the fence, then the hills behind it.

plates.title: A horse runs free
plates.prompt: Color the mane flying in the wind.

plates.title: A friendly hello
plates.prompt: Color the big old tree and its long branches.

plates.title: Brushing time
plates.prompt: Slow strokes. Color the tall grass around them.

plates.title: Time to rest
plates.prompt: Shhh — the pony is sleeping. Use quiet colors.

plates.title: Le cheval
plates.prompt: A new word today. Say it out loud, then color the meadow.

plates.title: Oink!
plates.prompt: Color the piggy and every bubble around it.

plates.title: Lunch together
plates.prompt: Everyone shares. Color the picnic in the shade.

plates.title: Little boats
plates.prompt: Color the water first, then the boats.

plates.title: At the water
plates.prompt: Color the ripples and the reeds.

plates.title: Aquaria
plates.prompt: A big wave rises. What color is the sea today?

plates.title: Sunset on the shore
plates.prompt: Color the sun going down behind her.

plates.title: Terrasol farm
plates.prompt: Color the barn red — or any color you choose.

plates.title: Keep on learning
plates.prompt: The sky opens up. Color the light shining down.

plates.title: Friends of Aquaria
plates.prompt: Two friends, head to toe. Color their clothes.

plates.title: Friends of Celestia
plates.prompt: Color their robes and their happy faces.

plates.title: Friends of Harmonia
plates.prompt: Color the music notes floating around them.

plates.title: Friends of Luminosity
plates.prompt: Give them a bright color that shines.

plates.title: Friends of Terrasol
plates.prompt: Color their boots for a day on the farm.

plates.title: Friends of Vitalis
plates.prompt: Stretch up tall! Color them strong and healthy.

plates.title: You did it!
plates.prompt: You walked the whole path. Color your celebration.
